name: Diplomat’s Ring, Greater
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 5th; Slot ring; Price 38,500 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears and functions as a diplomat’s ring, except it grants a +10 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks.

In addition to the comprehend languages ability 5 times per day, upon command the ring will grant the wearer the use of tongues up to 3 times per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells comprehend languages, tongues, Diplomacy 10 ranks, ring of at least 500 gp in value; Cost 19,500 gp

Identification DC 20
